summary: Requests arriving at the host from pages and tools, each with its route, its requester and a lifetime that ends when the request does.
rate: Tens per second at start; a few per interaction after.

x-friction.gap: An HTTP request's own abort isn't tied to the work it starts, so a page leaving doesn't stop host work; long work is polled by key instead.
x-friction.closes: Requests carrying who asked and a lifetime, with supersession scoped to the requester.
